name: The Whole of Our Hearts
source:
Two friends, Sean and Arthur, come back to their home town nestled in the mountains. After meeting up with their old friend Rocco, they learn that a sinkhole has opened up in the center of town. 

Cars and news vans fill the streets, but the town is as quiet as its always been. What's more, an old friend, Cody, has moved back after going to med school. With so much of their old life coming back what will change?

After all, nothing stays the same.

[From [url=https://thecrimsonflare.itch.io/the-whole-of-our-hearts]Itch.io[/url]]
